subject: Workplace Skills
title: The Micromanaging Boss
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Micromanaging Boss usable.

hook.text: He checked in three times daily, rewrote her emails, and hovered during presentations. She was ready to quit.

buildup.text: Micromanagement usually stems from fear, not malice. The boss is anxious about outcomes they are responsible for.

discovery.text: Proactive overcommunication is the antidote. If you give information before they ask, the anxiety fades.

twist.text: Fighting micromanagement with silence makes it worse. The less you share, the more they hover. It is a cycle.

climax.text: Flood them with updates for two weeks. As their anxiety drops, gradually reduce frequency. Trust rebuilds.

punchline.text: Overcommunicate first. The hovering gradually stops.

quiz.question: What is the most effective way to reduce micromanagement?
options: Confront the boss about their control issues
Proactively share updates before they ask to reduce their anxiety
Ask HR to intervene on your behalf
